result.description: Fictional desktop ambient-sound controller for studios, cafés, and relaxation spaces. The NoriMixer 24-Lite combines 24 loop banks, touch-sensitive cue pads, and dual-zone scheduling for seamless background audio curation. It uses a low-power Cortex-style control board, supports USB-C power, and includes editable scene presets for water, wind, and tonal textures.
